name: stretch-tool
description: Stretch Tool — macOS desktop app with a mini always-on-top timer

scripts.build: npm run sync && electron-packager . "Stretch Tool" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=dist --overwrite --ignore="^/(dist|test)($|/)" && node scripts/adhoc-sign.js
scripts.build:intel: npm run sync && electron-packager . "Stretch Tool" --platform=darwin --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --ignore="^/(dist|test)($|/)" && node scripts/adhoc-sign.js
scripts.build:universal: npm run sync && electron-packager . "Stretch Tool" --platform=darwin --arch=universal --out=dist --overwrite --ignore="^/(dist|test)($|/)" && node scripts/adhoc-sign.js
